transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in. 

Um... well, I guess I'm here because I just feel like I’m always running hot, if that makes sense? Like I just can’t ever really shut the motor off. Which, you know, usually is a pretty good thing for my job—I'm a firefighter, so being ready to go and having a lot of energy is a positive, right? 

But... lately, I guess it’s been getting me into a little bit of trouble at the firehouse. Nothing terrible, I don't think! Just some friction, maybe stepping on some toes without meaning to. I just really want to make sure I'm doing everything I can to be a good team player. Is that the kind of thing you help with?
Have there been times when your mood felt unusually high, euphoric, or more irritable than normal?
Oh, um... no, I don't think so? Not euphoric, anyway. I'm just naturally a pretty upbeat guy, I think. I really try to keep a positive
Does this high-energy, hard-to-shut-off feeling come in distinct periods, or is it pretty much how you’ve always been?

Oh, um... no, not distinct periods, I don't think. It’s... well, it’s pretty much just how I’ve always been, honestly. Ever since I was a kid. 

I've always just been a really active guy who likes to stay busy, you know? It doesn't really come and go in waves or anything like that. I just sort of wake up ready to go and stay that way. I just like being productive and helpful. 

I hope that's okay? Like, I hope I'm explaining that right for you. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the information you need.
Do you often have trouble staying focused on a task, even when you want to?
Well, um... I guess maybe a little bit? I wouldn't say it's a huge problem or anything, because I really do want to do a good job.
Do you often need reassurance from other people that you’re doing things the right way?

Um, no, I don't think so? I mean, I definitely want to make sure I'm doing a good job—especially at the firehouse, since, you know, people really rely on you. So I might double-check with the captain just to be absolutely sure we're on the same page. 

But I wouldn't say I constantly need people to tell me I'm doing things right. I just... I just like to know I'm being helpful and pulling my weight for the team. I try really hard to be a good guy to work with. 

Is that the kind of thing you're looking for? I just want to make sure I'm answering these right for you.
Do you often interrupt people or blurt things out before they’re finished speaking?

Well, um... I guess sometimes I might jump in a little early? It's not because I want to be rude, I promise. It's just... 

Like, if we're at the firehouse and the guys are talking through a plan, sometimes the answer just pops right into my head. And I just get so eager to help out and solve the problem that I'll just say it right then. I just want to contribute, you know? 

But then I realize I kind of cut somebody off, or stepped on what they were saying, and it messes up the flow of the whole discussion. I always feel really bad about it afterward. I try really hard to be a good team player and listen to everyone. 

Does that make sense? I hope I don't sound like a jerk or anything. I really do mean well when it happens.
Do you often have trouble reading other people’s social cues, like noticing when someone is getting annoyed or wants a turn to speak?

Um, no, I don't really think I have a hard time with that? I mean, I try to be really tuned in to the guys at the station. You kind of have to be, living together for 24 hours at a time. 

I guess sometimes I might get a little carried away if I'm really excited about an idea, and maybe I don't notice right away if someone else is trying to jump in. But as soon as I realize it, I always back off and let them talk. I'd hate for anyone to think I'm ignoring them or not caring about what they have to say. I really try to be respectful of everyone. 

Is that what you mean? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of examples. I just want to be as helpful as I can.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to solve?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I try not to be a worrier. There's enough actual stress on the job, you know? 

I guess sometimes I might overthink things a little bit, like if I want to make sure I handled a call the best way possible, or if I'm hoping I didn't let the captain down. But I wouldn't call it worrying exactly. It's more just... wanting to be prepared and do a good job for the team. I try to stay pretty positive and focused on the stuff I can actually fix. 

Does that sound okay? I just want to make sure I'm not making it sound like I'm anxious all the time, because I really do try to keep a good attitude about things.
